'''Jason Hairston''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[September 2000 Raleigh tournament]] on 2 September 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]], according to Mike Merletto's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1204">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-05-raleigh-nc-9-2-00d1204/ raleigh-nc-9-2-00], DeckTech (Mike "OQrygg" Merletto, 5 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-05-raleigh-nc-9-2-00d1204/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
